brief: Keep or replace the existing mark: compare it with two letter-first alternatives; one colour; must hold at 16px.

candidates.name: Current mark
candidates.idea: The mark the project already ships: a rounded square with one diagonal cut, used as the favicon.
candidates.tradeoff: Familiar to existing users; the cut closes up at 16px.
candidates.changes: fill #1f6feb replaced by currentColor; id attribute removed

candidates.name: Notch
candidates.idea: The initial letter with a notch cut from a square body; the notch is the one detail.
candidates.tradeoff: The strongest silhouette at 16px; reads as a generic letter without the wordmark.

candidates.name: Stack
candidates.idea: Three offset bars that read as a list, the thing the project manages.
candidates.tradeoff: Specific to the product; close to many list and menu icons.
